items.definition:
making money
The new business venture proved to be very profitable.

relating to a tribe
The region is known for its rich tribal history.

very strange or unusual
The dream I had last night was truly bizarre.

relating to a continent
They offer a continental breakfast at the hotel.

very large or impressive; excellent
That was a mega concert last night!

awaiting decision or settlement; about to happen
The outcome of the case is still pending.

complete and absolute; very thin
It was sheer joy to see them again.

concerned with the theories rather than the practical application of a subject
His knowledge was purely theoretical.

allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen
The glass was completely transparent.

done, given, or acting of one's own free will
She does a lot of voluntary work.

(of a bad, difficult, or unwelcome situation or phenomenon) present or experienced to a severe or intense degree
She has an acute sense of smell.

relating to the Celts or their languages
She is interested in Celtic music.

relating to a city or town or the people who live there
It is our civic duty to vote.

in a natural or raw state; not yet processed or refined
The country exports crude oil.

characteristic of one person or thing, and so serving to distinguish it from others
The building has a very distinctive architectural style.

independent (especially in music or film)
She prefers listening to indie music.

plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood
It was evident that she was upset.

opposed to
This material is resistant to water.

relating to sound or the sense of hearing
The acoustic guitar has a rich, natural sound.

relating to an atom or atoms
The atomic bomb changed warfare forever.

relating to or characteristic of the culture of computers, information technology, and virtual reality
Cyber security is a growing concern for businesses.

closely compacted in substance; stupid
The forest was very dense, making it hard to walk through.

undamaged; complete
Despite the fall, the vase remained intact.

not important or not related
That information is completely irrelevant to our discussion.

able to exist or occur together without conflict
Their personalities are very compatible.

able or likely to explode
The situation became explosive after the announcement.

relating to geography
They studied the geographic features of the region.

extreme or uncompromising
He's a hardcore fan of the band.

relating to Spain or Spanish-speaking countries
The Hispanic population is growing rapidly.

complete and careful
She did a thorough job cleaning the house.

relating to architecture
The city has many beautiful architectural designs.

having the form of a circle; round
The table was circular, perfect for a small group.

relating to a pole or extreme
The polar ice caps are melting.

excellent
The food at the restaurant was superb.

wildly unreasonable, illogical
That's an absurd idea.

having a strong desire for success
She is very ambitious and works hard.

having a hole or empty space inside
The tree trunk was hollow.

unable to walk properly; unconvincing
He gave a lame excuse for being late.

made by chemical synthesis; artificial
This fabric is made of synthetic fibers.

best or most favorable
We are looking for the optimal solution.

not affected by alcohol; serious and sensible
He remained sober throughout the party.

not awake and aware of one's surroundings
He was knocked unconscious after the fall.

relating to cars
The automotive industry is facing significant changes due to electric vehicles.

relating to sound
The jet broke the sonic barrier.

having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully
She is a very competent manager.

having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness
The tiger gave a fierce roar.

relating to the air
The drone provided an excellent aerial view of the landscape.

relating to charity; generous
She is known for her charitable donations.

from a distant foreign country; unusual
The market sold a variety of exotic fruits.

relating to women or girls
She has a very feminine style.

concerned with human welfare
The organization provides humanitarian aid to disaster victims.

situated at sea some distance from the coast
They built an offshore wind farm.

relating to the ownership of an area of land or sea
The dispute was over territorial waters.

relating to a person whose sense of personal identity and gender does not correspond with their birth sex
The organization supports transgender rights.

responsible for your actions
Leaders must be accountable to the public.

intended to be kept secret
This information is strictly confidential.

continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition
Her persistent efforts finally paid off.

(of a person or their manner) serious and unrelenting, especially in the assertion of authority and exercise of discipline
The teacher gave a stern warning.

preventing success or development; unfavorable
The company faced adverse economic conditions.

relating to cells
The human body is made of many cellular structures.

causing great damage or harm
The storm was very destructive.

having exceptional natural ability or talent
She is a gifted musician.

responsible by law; legally answerable
The company is liable for any damages.

trim
He kept himself in very trim condition.
